title: Functional Group Analysis
description: A <inode id="gat-vgae-encoder">GAT-VGAE</inode> and stratified SOM pipeline maps functional group enrichment across 249,455 ZINC15 molecules, using <inode id="alert-free-rescoring">counterfactual QED analysis</inode> to <inode id="entailed-vs-empirical">separate genuine chemistry from scoring-formula artefacts</inode>.

branches.label: Molecular Graph Encoding

nodes.title: ZINC15 Graph Construction
nodes.description: 249,455 Lipinski-compliant molecules become undirected graphs with 29-dimensional node features and 9-dimensional edge features, averaging 23.2 atoms and 24.9 bonds per molecule.

nodes.title: GAT-VGAE Encoder
nodes.description: Three graph attention layers with edge-aware attention and global attention pooling compress each graph into a 16-dimensional latent embedding, trained with a beta-weighted KL term (beta = 0.001) to avoid posterior collapse.

nodes.title: Reconstruction Quality
nodes.description: The encoder reaches a validation MSE of 0.0512 with only a 1.4% train/validation gap, and its latent dimension 0 strongly encodes phenyl presence (|r| = 0.543).

branches.description: Each of 249,455 ZINC15 molecules is <inode id="zinc15-graph-construction">converted into a graph</inode> and <inode id="gat-vgae-encoder">compressed into a 16-dimensional embedding</inode> for downstream clustering.

branches.label: Functional Group Detection

nodes.title: 22-Type Vocabulary
nodes.description: Substructure pattern matching covers six categories - oxygen-, nitrogen-, sulfur-containing groups, halogens, ring systems, and phosphate - spanning 22 functional group types.

nodes.title: Two-Pass Priority Matching
nodes.description: A priority-based two-pass algorithm resolves overlapping substructures so structures like rings are not double-counted as separate bonds.

nodes.title: RDKit Agreement
nodes.description: Detected functional groups agree with the RDKit reference tool 96.3% of the time on average, ranging from 91.8% for ketones to 99.7% for nitro groups.

branches.description: A rule-based substructure matcher labels each molecule's functional group composition before any clustering happens.

branches.label: QED-Stratified SOM Clustering

nodes.title: Five QED Strata
nodes.description: Automated valley detection on the QED distribution splits the dataset into five strata (S0-S4) at breakpoints 0.399, 0.520, 0.694, and 0.814, ranging from 6,830 to 83,673 molecules per stratum.

nodes.title: Autotuned Self-Organizing Maps
nodes.description: A separate SOM is trained per stratum on <inode id="gat-vgae-encoder">the 16-dimensional latent embeddings</inode>, with grid size auto-selected between 10x10 and 30x30 using a composite quantization/topographic error score.

nodes.title: FDR-Corrected Enrichment Testing
nodes.description: Cluster-level functional group enrichment is tested with Fisher's exact test across 68,836 comparisons, controlled with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction at alpha = 0.05.

branches.description: Molecules are <inode id="five-qed-strata">grouped by drug-likeness score</inode>, then <inode id="autotuned-som">clustered within each group</inode> to reveal structure invisible in the pooled dataset.

branches.label: Counterfactual QED Analysis

nodes.title: Alert-Free Rescoring
nodes.description: QED is recalculated as the geometric mean of seven non-alert desirability functions, dropping the structural-alert term entirely, and molecules are re-stratified using <inode id="five-qed-strata">the same valley-detection method</inode>.

nodes.title: Entailed vs. Empirical Decomposition
nodes.description: Comparing standard and alert-free QED strata splits an observed pattern into a component built into the scoring formula and a component reflecting real chemistry, applied to the nitro depletion gradient to yield a 78%/22% split.

branches.description: The study's core methodological contribution <inode id="alert-free-rescoring">recomputes drug-likeness with the structural-alert penalty removed</inode>, <inode id="entailed-vs-empirical">isolating genuine chemistry from scoring artefacts</inode>.

branches.label: Headline Enrichment Findings

nodes.title: Phenyl-Depleted Cluster 0
nodes.description: A high-QED cluster of 1,615 molecules (2.0% of Stratum 4) shows 7.2-fold phenyl depletion — separable in the first place because <inode id="reconstruction-quality">the latent space strongly encodes phenyl presence</inode> — alongside enrichment for thioether, tertiary amine, and ether groups, evidencing drug-likeness achieved without aromatic dominance.

nodes.title: Sulfonamide-Heterocycle-Nitrile Signature
nodes.description: Sulfonyl-enriched clusters consistently co-enrich for nitrile and heterocyclic nitrogen across all five QED strata, a non-random co-occurrence matching known kinase-inhibitor and sulfonamide-antibacterial pharmacophores.

nodes.title: Carboxylate-Bearing Cluster 899
nodes.description: The largest high-QED cluster (n=3,347) shows 3.67-fold carboxyl enrichment, challenging the assumption that carboxylic acids preclude oral bioavailability.

nodes.title: Nitro Depletion Gradient
nodes.description: Nitro prevalence falls monotonically from 29.6% in the lowest QED stratum to 1.3% in the highest, a greater than 22-fold reduction that <inode id="entailed-vs-empirical">the counterfactual analysis</inode> splits into a 78% scoring-formula effect and a 22% genuine chemical effect.

branches.description: Applying the pipeline surfaces four concrete patterns in drug-like chemical space, each validated with enrichment ratios and significance testing.
